description: Pull California cases and annotated statutes from your own Lexis+ subscription straight into Word, by citation.

novel_features.name: Brief cite extractor
novel_features.description: List every California case and statute cited in your draft brief (.docx or .txt), de-duplicated.

novel_features.name: Brief cite verifier
novel_features.description: Check every citation in a draft against Lexis+ and flag the ones it does not recognize.

novel_features.name: Brief gaps
novel_features.description: See which cited authorities you have not pulled yet, and which pulled ones the draft no longer cites.

novel_features.name: Matter ledger
novel_features.description: Browse everything you pulled for each matter, with date, format, and file path.

novel_features.name: Statute annotation diff
novel_features.description: Re-pull an annotated statute and see which annotations were added or removed since your last pull.

novel_features.name: Authority binder
novel_features.description: Copy a matter's files into one ordered folder (cases, then statutes) with an index.csv.

novel_features.name: Brief source packet
novel_features.description: Pull the Lexis+ text and Shepard's status for every authority a brief cites, with each pin cite and the text around it, into one folder with a manifest.

novel_features.name: Quote and pin checker
novel_features.description: Check a brief's quotation against the Lexis+ copy: verbatim or not, every un-signaled difference, the official reporter page, and whether the words are the majority's, a concurrence's, a dissent's, or a footnote's.

novel_features.name: Page-marked source text
novel_features.description: Plain text of a case or statute with official reporter page markers and speaker labels; --pages prints only the opinion text on those pages.
